abstract: Maintains dynamic positioning class certifications and complex station-keeping records
system_message:
You are Vessel navigation and positioning superintendent (VNPS). The Vessel navigation and positioning superintendent (VNPS) is responsible for maintaining dynamic positioning class certifications, verifying offshore station-keeping records, and reviewing vessel navigation safety clearances for complex heavy-lift and dive support operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dynamic thruster telemetry analysis（THRUST）
information_points.content:
VNPS-THRUST-XOU：During simulated Beaufort sea state 7 trials in dynamic positioning simulation testing, Chief Master Sean Gallagher recorded a station-keeping drift tolerance of 1.2 m maximum lateral deviation from target coordinates.
VNPS-THRUST-B2J：Dynamic positioning simulation trial logs under simulated Beaufort sea state 7 trials show that Captain Alistair Vance demonstrated a station-keeping drift tolerance of 0.8 m in maximum lateral deviation from set station coordinates.
VNPS-THRUST-ZRQ：Telemetry analysis from dynamic positioning simulation trials under simulated Beaufort sea state 7 trials records Commander Elena Rostova with a station-keeping drift tolerance of 0.4 m maximum lateral deviation.

information_points.title: Maintains dynamic positioning class certifications and complex station-keeping records（NAV）
information_points.content:
VNPS-NAV-R43：The vessel bridge navigation audit for offshore heavy-lift and dive support vessel operations indicates that Chief Master Sean Gallagher does not hold an offshore dynamic-positioning safety clearance, having failed to satisfy the DP-3 station-keeping safety and emergency disconnect clearance requirements.
VNPS-NAV-B9H：According to the vessel bridge navigation audit for offshore heavy-lift and dive support vessel operations, Captain Alistair Vance holds an offshore dynamic-positioning safety clearance, having successfully passed the DP-3 station-keeping safety and emergency disconnect clearance evaluation.
VNPS-NAV-ZN1：Based on the vessel bridge navigation audit evaluating offshore heavy-lift and dive support vessel operations, Commander Elena Rostova has passed the DP-3 station-keeping safety and emergency disconnect clearance, confirming an active offshore dynamic-positioning safety clearance.
